evidence: Static prose is stale relative to the repository inventory.

issue: Historical T10 remains 'in progress' and PR record 'pending' despite a later final completion entry.
evidence: Line 212 reports T1–T10 all done; later records report PR #2 merged and Pages built.
action: Append a correction/cross-reference; do not rewrite append-only history.

issue: Positive same-game dependence is described as making an independence product 'overstate' joint probability.
evidence: For positive lift, P(A∩B) > P(A)P(B), so the product understates the joint hit probability.
action: New analysis uses observed joint rates and labels the direction correctly; foreign file is not edited.

issue: Lag-1 scoring autocorrelation is used to support cross-game parlay independence.
evidence: Adjacent scoring diagnostics do not establish independence of actual offered parlay legs, slate effects or settlement outcomes.
action: New G05 remains blocked without a validated joint model for the exact legs.

issue: The 125-row sample is called the top two 2025–26 scorers.
evidence: Official leaders: Dončić 33.5, Gilgeous-Alexander 31.1, Edwards 28.8; Edwards is third.
action: New workspace labels the sample as two selected high-usage players, not the top two.

issue: Lag checks are described as an independence probe for multi-game parlays.
evidence: The probe measures serial scoring association, not the joint distribution of betting legs.
action: Use it only as a diagnostic; require exact-leg dependence evidence for certification.

issue: Fisher-z intervals are applied to pooled repeated player-game observations.
evidence: Repeated games within two selected players and shared dates violate a simple independent-observation interpretation.
action: New report gives per-player conditional block-bootstrap intervals and leaves centered pooled intervals blank.

issue: Header contains both ASCII blk_pg and a visually confusable Cyrillic-a blkа_pg field.
evidence: The same header pattern also appears in teams_2025_26.csv; downstream consumers may select the wrong column.
action: New CSVs use ASCII headers only; inherited files remain untouched under coordination scope.

issue: Shared link checker enumerates only root-level HTML files.
evidence: Category pages under pages/ and other dashboards are outside this root-only scan.
action: New checker scans every page in this workspace; final integration also runs the existing root checks and a scoped browser/link pass.

issue: Session 6d508fee task rows M2–M12 remain 'unclaimed' although later logs report them done.
evidence: Line 595 reports M1–M12 DONE; the board and completion log disagree.
action: Append a status reconciliation in this session's final record; preserve historical rows.

issue: Power sample sizes are normal approximations presented as approximate values.
evidence: Exact one-sided binomial search gives 2,248 at 55%, 726 at 57%, 269 at 60% for the stated -110 null; the old values were 2,243/719/263.
action: New power table is exact and labels the hypothetical price; no inherited result is silently overwritten.

issue: Existing suites emit ResourceWarnings from unclosed file handles.
evidence: settle.py line 22 and check.py line 71 use open() without a context manager; all 146 baseline tests still passed.
action: New code uses context managers; foreign files are flagged rather than edited.

issue: NBA and FanDuel rendered start times differ by ten minutes.
evidence: NBA schedule: 9:00/10:00 PM ET; FanDuel event render: 9:10/10:10 PM ET. Reason unverified.
